hero.subtitle: We design and build robust web applications and platforms for ambitious founders and teams who value extreme velocity.

whyUs.cartouche: Lonside was created with a simple conviction: enable founders and ambitious teams to ship world-class digital products at the speed of thought. At Lonside, we employ zero account managers, zero salespeople, and we outsource no work. Every platform is designed, architected, and built directly by a seasoned Lead Architect dedicated to a strictly limited roster of clients at a time.
whyUs.label: Our commitment
whyUs.description: Lonside delivers unprecedented velocity and total certainty: fixed-price engineering sprints shipped in as little as 14 days, with 100% source code transferred to your own GitHub repository, executed so fast and cleanly you won't want to build software any other way.

work.label: Selected work
work.title: Thoughtfully crafted products,
work.description: Here are a few applications and platforms we have engineered alongside their founders. From the first wireframe to the official release, each project solves a concrete business need with precision and clarity.

manifesto.label: Our studio vision
manifesto.title: Building software,
manifesto.description: Launching a new product demands courage and energy. Working with us should feel energizing and crystal clear, not like an anxiety-inducing loop of vague quotes and cascading delays. We founded Lonside on three simple commitments.

commitments.title: A promise kept on deadlines and budget
commitments.subtitle: Fixed price • Zero hidden costs
commitments.desc: Before typing a single line of code, we thoroughly define what truly moves the needle for your business. Once scope is sealed, our commitment is absolute: the price does not change by a single cent, and the delivery date is locked. You know exactly where you are heading.

commitments.title: 100% code ownership, zero vendor lock-in
commitments.subtitle: Your GitHub account • Full transfer
commitments.desc: Every line of code, database schema, and UI component is committed directly to your private GitHub repository. You are never captive to a proprietary platform or forced subscription. You remain free to scale with us or in total autonomy.

commitments.title: Craftsman care, battle-tested for real users
commitments.subtitle: Rigorous testing • 30-day warranty
commitments.desc: We genuinely care about the craft. Your application is not a fragile prototype: it arrives tested, responsive, documented, ready to onboard real users and process live payments. And if any fine-tuning is needed, our 30-day corrective warranty has you covered with zero extra fees.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.content: All trademarks, visual assets, codebases, and brand elements on this domain are the exclusive property of Lonside Studio. Unauthorized reproduction is strictly prohibited.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.content: Lonside maintains accurate and updated technical documentation. Contractual timelines and fixed prices are exclusively established through signed scoping agreements.

sections.title: Scope & Application
sections.content: These Terms govern all high-velocity software engineering engagements (Sprint Launch 14d, Sprint Scale 30d, and Embedded Immersion Squads) delivered by Lonside Studio.

sections.title: Fixed Pricing & Firm Deliveries
sections.content: Every sprint is bound by an immutable scope definition, fixed upfront pricing, and a guaranteed delivery deadline backed by contractual SLA penalties.

sections.title: Full Intellectual Property Handover
sections.content: 100% of source code, schemas, infrastructure configurations, and software assets are transferred under exclusive license upon final payment clearance.

sections.title: 30-Day Bug-Fix Warranty
sections.content: Every project includes 30 consecutive calendar days of comprehensive bug-fix warranty at zero additional cost following production launch.

sections.title: Applicable Law
sections.content: All commercial agreements are governed by French law with exclusive jurisdiction granted to Bordeaux commercial courts.

sections.title: Minimal Data Collection
sections.content: Lonside collects only business contact data submitted through our scoping form (name, company, corporate email, project scope) strictly for engineering responses under 24 hours.

sections.title: Zero Data Retention & AI Privacy
sections.content: All AI-accelerated workflows run under verified enterprise Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreements. Your proprietary code and schemas are never retained or trained on.

sections.title: Privacy-Respecting Analytics
sections.content: Subject to your explicit consent, we track anonymized traffic trends with Vercel Web Analytics, PostHog EU, and Google Tag Manager / Google Analytics (Consent Mode v2). No personal identity is ever recorded.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: Under GDPR regulations, you maintain permanent rights of access, modification, and deletion by contacting hello@lonside.com.

sections.title: Essential Only
sections.content: We store strictly necessary technical cookies (session state, language choice, consent status). No third-party ad trackers are used.

sections.title: Consent Management
sections.content: Optional audience measurement is activated only upon explicit consent and can be revoked at any time via the settings panel.

cookieConsent.title: Cookie Management
cookieConsent.description: We respect your digital privacy. Only strictly necessary operational cookies are active by default. You can opt in to anonymized analytics.
cookieConsent.essentialDesc: Required for website operation (session, security, locale). Cannot be disabled.

sprint-mvp-14-jours.intro: Turn a validated concept into a live, secure web application ready to onboard real users and collect Stripe revenue in two weeks. Zero account managers, zero budget creep, 100% IP transfer from commit one.
idealFor: Founders validating demand with production software instead of throwaway prototypes
Pre-seed and seed teams preparing investor demos or onboarding their first 50 paying users
SMBs launching a customer portal or internal tool without enduring a 6-month build cycle

deliverables.title: Responsive full-stack web application
deliverables.desc: Precision mobile-first interface built on Next.js 16 and strict TypeScript, engineered for Core Web Vitals and clean technical SEO from day one.

deliverables.title: Authentication, sessions & hardened database
deliverables.desc: PostgreSQL / Supabase schema with Row Level Security (RLS), session management, and strict tenant data isolation.

deliverables.title: Stripe billing & transactional email stack

deliverables.desc: Every commit lands directly in your private GitHub repository alongside architecture documentation and a Loom code walkthrough.

faq.q: Can a 14-day MVP really be production-grade with zero technical debt?
faq.a: Yes. We eliminate discovery bloat and build on our battle-tested Next.js 16, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Stripe foundation—dedicating 100% of sprint bandwidth to your core differentiating workflow.

faq.q: What happens if the studio misses the locked delivery date?
faq.a: Delivery dates are backed by a contractual SLA: a 10% fee refund applies for every 48 hours of studio-attributable delay.

faq.q: Can our internal engineers take over immediately after launch?
faq.a: Yes. You hold 100% ownership of the private GitHub repo built on standard TypeScript and React conventions, backed by our complete Handover Pack.

application-web-nextjs.intro: We architect and ship custom web applications on Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Components, strict TypeScript). Instant user interfaces, rock-solid technical SEO, and clean codebases any senior team can maintain.
idealFor: Companies whose web product must excel at both organic SEO acquisition and interactive speed
Teams migrating a sluggish SPA or legacy stack to Next.js 16 and TypeScript
Client portals, marketplaces, interactive calculators, and high-traffic B2B platforms

comparisonRows.lonside: Built into routing & SSG from day 1

faq.q: Why does Lonside standardize on Next.js 16 and TypeScript?
faq.a: Next.js unifies server-rendered speed, technical SEO, and modern React interactivity on the industry’s most maintainable and hireable web engineering stack.

faq.q: Can you migrate an existing web app or no-code prototype to Next.js?
faq.a: Yes. We handle clean migrations from legacy stacks or no-code tools while preserving SEO equity with zero-hop 301 redirects and safe database migrations.
Never. We deploy directly into your own Vercel, AWS, Scaleway, or Docker infrastructure so you retain 100% operational sovereignty.

idealFor: B2B founders launching vertical SaaS in PropTech, Supply Chain, Mobility, EventTech, or FinTech
Companies replacing brittle spreadsheets or saturated no-code tools with proprietary software
Teams requiring strict multi-tenant security, granular RBAC, real-time webhooks, and automated test suites

faq.q: How are the 30 business days structured?
faq.a: Across two crisp milestones: Milestone 1 (Days 1–15) ships data architecture, multi-role auth, and core business logic; Milestone 2 (Days 16–30) delivers integrations, billing, automated tests, and production rollout.

faq.q: Can you integrate Python computation services or predictive models?
faq.a: Yes. When workloads require dedicated compute (such as inventory forecasting on Michi or sub-5ms dispatch on Bely), we pair Next.js with optimized PostgreSQL and Python FastAPI pipelines.

faq.q: Where can we inspect real platforms you have shipped?
faq.a: Review our full architectural dossiers for Welqo (real-time PropTech + eIDAS), Bely (executive mobility dispatch), and Michi (supply chain forecasting).
